Doctor: Could you please provide your age, gender, and a detailed description of your headaches, including their frequency, duration, location, and any associated symptoms? They’re pretty intense, like a seven out of ten when they first come on, and they last throughout the day. I take Tylenol for them, and it helps a little, bringing them down to maybe a four or five. I’m on lisinopril, but I sometimes forget to take it, especially on the weekends. Doctor: Could you please share if you have any history of high blood pressure, heart disease, or neurological conditions in your family? Also, have you noticed any other symptoms such as dizziness, chest pain, shortness of breath, or visual changes along with the headaches? Patient: I don't have any family history of high blood pressure or heart disease that I'm aware of. As for other symptoms, I haven't had any dizziness, chest pain, shortness of breath, or visual changes with the headaches. Doctor: Could you describe the pattern of your headaches in more detail? For example, do they occur at specific times of the day, are they worse with certain activities, or do they wake you up at night?
